What is SAIF Paper Generator?

SAIF Paper Generator is a free online test paper maker for teachers and schools in Pakistan. Pick a class, a subject and the chapters you have taught — the tool builds a complete board-pattern test paper in seconds, with MCQs, short questions and long questions, plus a teacher's answer key. The bank holds 8,020 questions across 406 chapters for Classes 9, 10, 11 and 12, and everything runs right in your browser: no sign-up, no installation, no fee. Type your own school's name at the top, then print the paper or save it as a PDF.

Classes & Subjects Covered

Every chapter below is filled with real questions — 10 MCQs, 6 short and 4 long questions per chapter, in English and Urdu (Class 12 Computer Science chapters carry 5 MCQs, 3 short and 2 long). Islamiyat is offered for Classes 9, 10 and 11, and Pakistan Studies for Classes 9, 10 and 12, exactly as in the Punjab board scheme.

How to Make a Paper — 3 Simple Steps

  1. Choose your class & chapters. Select your class (9, 10, 11 or 12) and subject, tick the chapters you want questions from, and set how many MCQs, short and long questions you need — the total marks update automatically.
  2. Generate your paper. Press Generate Paper. Questions are spread evenly across your chapters with no repeats, and any single question can be replaced with its Swap button. Open the Answer Key whenever you need the teacher's copy.
  3. Print or save as PDF. Press Print / PDF for a clean paper carrying your own school's name. You can also save papers in your browser and reuse them later.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is SAIF Paper Generator really free?

Yes — completely free. There is no sign-up, no subscription and no per-paper charge. Open the page, make your paper and print it; that is all.

Which classes and subjects are covered?

Classes 9, 10, 11 and 12 (Matric and FSc) — Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science, Math, English, Urdu, Islamiyat and Pakistan Studies: 406 chapters and 8,020 questions in total, following the Punjab board pattern.

Does every paper include an answer key?

Yes. Press Show Answer Key after generating and you get the teacher's copy with the correct option for every MCQ and the key and marking points for short and long questions. The key prints on a separate page only when you leave it open.

Can I put my own school's name on the paper?

Yes. Type your institute's name in the Institute Name box at the top — that exact name is printed as the paper's header. Any school or academy can use the tool with its own name.

Can I print the paper or download it as a PDF?

Yes. Press Print / PDF: the printout contains only the clean paper — no buttons, ads or settings. From the print window you can print directly or choose 'Save as PDF'. You can also save papers inside your browser and reopen them any time.

For School Owners — Run Your Whole School from One App

Making papers is only one part of running a school. The SAIF School App — the app advertised alongside this tool — is a complete, fully offline school management app for Pakistani schools: students and classes, attendance, fees with vouchers and reminders, tests, results and report cards, all on your phone with no internet needed. If you would like the same system for your own institute, with your school's name and logo, message us on WhatsApp at 0303 4184485.
